clue.text: Chafe maybe about the silly ass's flannel

indicators.note: the rearranged letters go about, i.e. around, the word for a silly ass
'maybe' says the letters of chafe could be arranged some other way

parts.note: a clot is a stupid person, a silly ass

explanation.surface: Someone gets irritated by a fool's piece of cloth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flannel' could be idle talk; here it is the British word for a small washing cloth.
explanation.definitionFit: In Britain a flannel is the small square of towelling used for washing the face.

clue.text: Pastries served up doused in spirit would be excellent

indicators.note: doused in spirit means soaked inside the spirit word

parts.note: fire is spirit or ardour, as in someone full of fire

indicators.note: in a down clue 'served up' means the word is written upwards

parts.note: tarts are pastries

explanation.surface: Desserts flambéed in brandy would be a treat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'doused' suggests liquor poured over pastries, but the spirit is ardour, not brandy.
explanation.definitionFit: First-rate means of the highest class, top-notch.

clue.text: A showy plant Scots can not produce

definitions.meaning: a tropical plant with bright flowers

explanation.surface: Scots cannot grow a flamboyant flower.
explanation.definitionFit: It names a bright-flowered tropical plant and is Scots dialect for cannot.

clue.text: Establishing credit, being a consumer

parts.note: CR is the abbreviation for credit in accounts
someone eating is consuming food

explanation.surface: A shopper builds a credit rating.
explanation.definitionFit: Creating something is founding or bringing it into being.

clue.text: Nothing but trouble — Class is to close

parts.note: O looks like zero, nothing

indicators.note: to trouble something is to disturb it, so its letters are stirred

parts.note: rate means class, as in first-rate

explanation.surface: A complaint that a school class causes nothing but bother before shutting down.
explanation.definitionFit: Obturate is a technical verb meaning to block or stop up an opening.

clue.text: Hector has captive artists

indicators.note: has holds the artists captive, around them

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, so RAs are artists

explanation.surface: A man named Hector keeps some painters prisoner.
explanation.definitionFit: To hector is to bully or badger, to pester persistently.

clue.text: Soldiers play cricket in Morocco

parts.note: RA is the Royal Artillery, a body of soldiers
to bat is to take your turn at the crease in cricket

explanation.surface: Troops enjoy a game of cricket while stationed in North Africa.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a place found in Morocco: its capital city.
explanation.definitionFit: The capital city of Morocco lies on its Atlantic coast.

clue.text: It's a sound axiom to retain a good man

indicators.note: the axiom word holds the good man inside

parts.note: a rule is a principle or axiom
ST is saint, a good man

explanation.surface: A sound principle is to keep a good employee.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sound' looks like an adjective meaning reliable; it is a noise.
explanation.definitionFit: A rustle is a soft crackling noise, as of leaves or paper.

clue.text: An old missile that's making a comeback

definitions.text: An old missile that's making a comeback

parts.words: An old missile that's making a comeback
parts.note: an ancient throwing weapon designed to return to the thrower, read as a revival

explanation.definitionFit: The curved Aboriginal throwing stick flies back to the thrower.

clue.text: Taking article on feet

parts.note: the is the definite article

explanation.surface: Picking up something on foot.
explanation.definitionFit: Theft is the act of stealing, taking what is not yours.

clue.text: The line taken by the French is most offensive

indicators.note: the word for line is taken on by the French word that follows it

parts.note: a rank is a line, as of soldiers or taxis
est is the French for 'is'

explanation.surface: A political stance adopted in France is judged extremely objectionable.
explanation.definitionFit: Rank as an adjective means foul-smelling or gross, so the superlative is the most foul or objectionable.

clue.text: Refresh with a mineral after an interval

indicators.note: the mineral word comes after the interval word

parts.note: a rest is a pause or interval
ore is mineral-bearing rock

explanation.surface: Someone revives themselves with a mineral drink after a break.
explanation.definitionFit: To refresh something is to renew or bring it back to its former state.

clue.text: Way to treat bread in health proposal

definitions.meaning: bread can be browned under a grill or in a toaster
proposing someone's health is raising glasses to them

explanation.surface: Grilling slices of bread as part of a healthy plan.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: browning bread by heat, and a drink raised in someone's honour.

clue.text: Quick to recover from inter-isle peregrination

indicators.note: a peregrination is a wandering journey, so the letters roam into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone bounces back quickly after a trip around the islands.
explanation.walkthrough: 'peregrination' (wandering) rearranges the nine letters of INTER-ISLE.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone resilient springs back fast from hardship or illness.

clue.text: Turn away a legal right and a note is made

parts.note: a lien is a legal right to hold property until a debt is paid
te is the seventh note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A lawyer claims a legal right and drafts a memo to rebuff someone.
explanation.definitionFit: To alienate people is to estrange them, making them turn away from you.

clue.text: Ten trains are to be diverted without delay

indicators.note: trains that are diverted take a new route, so the letters are rerouted

explanation.surface: Ten trains must be rerouted immediately.
explanation.definitionFit: Instanter is a formal or legal word meaning immediately, at once.

clue.text: Tip offered by many a social worker

definitions.meaning: to tip is to tilt or slope

definitions.text: offered by many a social worker
definitions.meaning: jargon or hypocritical, pious talk, as in professional patter

explanation.surface: Advice handed out by a typical social worker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tip' looks like a piece of advice, but it means to tilt.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a slant or tilt and insincere jargon-laden talk.

clue.text: The handling of persons with complaints?

definitions.text: The handling of persons with complaints?

parts.words: The handling of persons with complaints?
parts.note: complaints are illnesses, and dealing with patients is medical care

explanation.definitionFit: Medical care given to patients is the handling of their illnesses.

clue.text: Under pressure to give up sweets

indicators.note: in a down clue 'up' means the word is written upwards

parts.note: desserts are sweets, puddings

explanation.surface: A dieter feeling the strain of giving up puddings.
explanation.definitionFit: Being stressed is being tense and strained.

clue.text: He executed an order including scriptural books

indicators.note: the order word includes the books inside it

parts.note: the Garter is the senior order of English knighthood
OT is the Old Testament

explanation.surface: A man carried out a command involving holy texts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'He executed' means one who executed, by strangling.
explanation.definitionFit: One who killed by strangulation, an executioner using a cord.

clue.text: Language that's a bit oversentimental

indicators.note: 'a bit' of the long word means a short run of its letters forms the answer

explanation.surface: A remark that some language is rather too sentimental.
explanation.definitionFit: Erse is an old name for the Gaelic tongue of Scotland or Ireland.

clue.text: It's odd about the cash squeeze

indicators.note: the word for odd goes about, around, the cash letter

parts.note: odd means strange
L stands for the pound, from Latin libra, hence money or cash

explanation.surface: A credit crunch strikes someone as peculiar.
explanation.definitionFit: To strangle is to squeeze the throat; figuratively to choke off.

clue.text: Mounting use of private transport in the Aegean area

indicators.note: the turned vehicle word goes in the word the
in a down clue 'Mounting' means the word is written upwards

parts.note: a car is the private vehicle people use

explanation.surface: More people drive their own cars around the Greek islands.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is the ancient region on the north shore of the Aegean, not an island.
explanation.definitionFit: The ancient region lies on the northern coast of the Aegean Sea.

clue.text: The players or the star

parts.note: a cast is the troupe of actors in a play

explanation.surface: The supporting actors or the lead.
explanation.walkthrough: 'star' looks like the lead actor; it is a real star in Gemini.
explanation.definitionFit: One of the twin bright stars of the Gemini constellation.

clue.text: The speed at which people go!

definitions.text: The speed at which people go!

parts.words: The speed at which people go!
parts.note: 'go' means die, so the speed is the rate of dying in a population

explanation.surface: A remark on how fast people walk.
explanation.definitionFit: The statistic counts deaths per thousand of a population each year.

clue.text: Note skill's required in this game

parts.note: D is a musical note
art is skill, and the 's adds S

explanation.surface: Scoring in this pub game needs some skill.
explanation.walkthrough: In a game of darts, players throw small arrows at a board.
explanation.definitionFit: Darts is a pub game of throwing small arrows at a numbered board.

clue.text: A little hooter

parts.note: a hooter is an owl, so a little one is a young owl

explanation.definitionFit: A young or small owl, a bird that hoots.

clue.text: Everyone getting a rise (about a thousand) can be a beast

indicators.note: in a down clue a rise means the word is written upwards

parts.note: all means everyone

indicators.note: 'about' turns the following pair round

parts.note: M is the Roman numeral for a thousand

explanation.surface: Everyone getting a pay rise of a thousand might become an animal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting a rise' turns ALL into LLA; 'about' turns A M into MA.
explanation.definitionFit: A South American animal, a woolly relative of the camel.

clue.text: Disown touching disquisition

parts.note: re means concerning or touching on
a tract is a treatise or disquisition

explanation.surface: Someone repudiates a moving treatise.
explanation.definitionFit: To retract a statement is to take it back or withdraw it.

clue.text: Fill up at it, as changing direction

indicators.note: 'changing' says the letters of at it, as are rearranged

parts.note: E is east, a compass direction

explanation.surface: Eat your fill while turning to face another way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'changing' rearranges ATITAS into SATIAT; E (east) follows.
explanation.definitionFit: To satiate is to satisfy fully, to glut.

clue.text: Good quality stuff — Russian

definitions.meaning: a common Russian man's first name

explanation.surface: Fine material from Russia.
explanation.definitionFit: It is both a hard-wearing worsted cloth and a Russian man's name.

clue.text: The flier must take a stand about crumbly bread

indicators.note: the word for stand goes about the rearranged letters

parts.note: to rest is to stand or stay put

indicators.note: crumbly bread falls apart, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A bird takes up its position near some crumbs of bread.
explanation.walkthrough: The flier is the robin, named for its red chest.
explanation.definitionFit: The robin is a bird known by its red chest.
